objective: Remove the proven packed-prefill order dependence by isolating only the post-norm GDN output projection at live request boundaries.

treatment.selection: Use live GDNAttentionMetadata pure-prefill request boundaries inside an opaque custom op.
treatment.multi_request_prefill: After the existing R101 R97 normalization, flatten each request independently, run the existing FP8 out_proj on that request's natural rows, and concatenate in the original scheduler order.
treatment.unchanged: R99 single-request norm, R97 multi-request norm, qkvz isolation, native GDN request isolation, model weights, scheduler order, decode path, and single-request output projection.
treatment.forbidden: No prompt-length, prompt-content, request-position, fixture-row, or oracle-token heuristics.

resource_boundary: Use 12 GiB container RAM and 16 GiB RAM-plus-swap; no reboot or GPU reset.

decision.pass: Build a non-tracing production candidate and proceed to repeated varied-prompt strict and depth/concurrency qualification on a clean boot.
decision.fail: Preserve the result. If order dependence survives, trace normalized and projected per-request digests before another arithmetic change.

reporting_boundary: Diagnostic only on this boot. No public speed, README headline, website, or LocalMaxxing update.
